disclaimer: From GSA SmartPay's state tax pages. Local (city/county) lodging taxes can still apply — confirm with the hotel.

AK.name: Alaska
AK.note: Alaska has no state sales tax. Municipal and county governments may assess other taxes with their own exemption rules.

AL.name: Alabama
AL.note: GSA lists centrally billed accounts as exempt from state sales tax and shows nothing lodging-specific for travelers.

AR.name: Arkansas
AR.note: GSA lists centrally billed accounts as exempt from state sales tax and shows nothing lodging-specific for travelers.

AZ.name: Arizona
AZ.note: Individually billed accounts are not exempt from transaction privilege tax; centrally billed accounts may not be either (the merchant can request an exemption).

CA.name: California
CA.note: GSA lists centrally billed accounts as exempt from state sales tax and shows nothing lodging-specific for travelers.

CO.name: Colorado
CO.note: Colorado's government-credit-card affidavit is listed for the travel card (DR 1367 was consolidated into DR 5002).
CO.form: DR 5002 Standard Colorado Affidavit of Exempt Sale

CT.name: Connecticut

DC.note: GSA lists centrally billed accounts as exempt from state sales tax and shows nothing lodging-specific for travelers.

DE.name: Delaware
DE.note: The federal government is exempt from the occupancy tax.
DE.form: Form 6100: Exemption Certificate from Tax on Occupancy of Hotel, Motel and Tourist Home Rooms

FL.name: Florida
FL.note: Florida says a certificate of exemption is not required for federal government employees (a merchant may still ask for one for its records).

GA.name: Georgia
GA.note: The $5.00 hotel-motel fee does not apply to hotel rooms rented by the federal government when a centrally billed card is the form of payment.
GA.form: State of Georgia Certificate of Exemption of Local Hotel/Motel Excise Tax

HI.name: Hawaii
HI.note: Individually billed accounts are not exempt from the general excise tax (GET) or the transient accommodations tax (TAT); centrally billed accounts may be exempt from GET.

IA.note: GSA lists centrally billed accounts as exempt from state sales tax and shows nothing lodging-specific for travelers.
